Onboard a repository to docz-api

Adds a repository to docz-api without waiting for the GitHub App's installation event.

Overview

Service: docz-api

Owner: Platform team

When to Use

  • A repository was added to the App but never appeared in docz-site

Prerequisites

  • kubectl access to the docz namespace
  • The App's installation ID

Procedures

Procedures

Procedure 1: Onboard by hand

Written before the template, so its steps are headings.

Steps
Step 1: Find the installation ID

Open the App's settings and copy the ID from the URL.

Step 2: Run the onboard flag
docz-api -onboard acme/widgets@12345
Verification
  • The repository is listed by GET /api/v1/repos
Rollback

Rollback

  1. 1.R1 Delete the repository row; the next install event re-adds it.

Procedure 2: Re-index search

Steps

Scenarios

Troubleshooting

The onboard flag exits with "repo not found"
Symptom
The onboard flag exits with "repo not found"
Alert
none
Likely cause
the App is not installed on the repository
Steps
  1. S1.1 Diagnose: list the installation's repositories. 
    gh api /installation/repositories --jq '.repositories[].full_name'
  2. S1.2 Resolve: add the repository to the installation, then retry Procedure 1.

Escalation

Who When How
Platform on-call The onboard flag fails twice #platform in Slack
